_about: The code points Rust is_deceptive_char (src-tauri/src/ssh/shellquote.rs) and the frontend displayServerText (src/lib/serverText.ts) treat as invisible or deceptive, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 9.5. A Rust and a Vitest test check every code point against this list. 'control' is C0, DEL and C1 (Rust: char::is_control). 'deceptive' is the is_deceptive_char set. 'presentationSelectors' are inside 'deceptive' for Rust; the frontend escapes them on their own and keeps them only after an emoji whose presentation they change. Ranges are inclusive hex code points.
